- Strata splits work across GPU, RAM, and SSD: VRAM holds attention/mixers, KV cache, and hot experts; RAM stores all experts; SSD stores the large n-gram table, with direct I/O preferred on SSDs.

- It uses speculative decoding via the model’s MTP layer and prompt lookup, and processes prompts in large chunks with tuned expert streaming/ring buffers, trading some bit-level changes for speed.

- Strata is MIT-licensed, but model weights have separate licenses; it relies on Qwen models, GGUF quantizations, and llama.cpp/ggml components.
